name: AmericasNLP 2021 — Open MT shared task (test)
description: AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task on Open Machine Translation — the held-out test set for Spanish → Indigenous languages of the Americas (Aymara, Bribri, Asháninka, Guaraní, Wixarika, Hñähñu/Otomi, Quechua, Shipibo-Konibo, Rarámuri). Multi-parallel: one Spanish source (test_data/test.es) translated into each target (test_data/test.{lang}); each direction is scored es→xx (the shared-task direction). Nahuatl is excluded (mixed-variety macro code, no honest single-variety card). Fetched on demand from the task's GitHub repo at a pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Domain 'conv' (general elicited sentences). Contamination HIGH — public since 2021, memorized — so scores are relative-comparison-only. License is UNSTATED upstream and aggregates heterogeneous per-language sources (incl. religious JW300 for Quechua), so the set is tagged non-commercial and is held by the license review of 2026-08-24 — mixed, partly unstated terms are never interpreted on the rights-holders' behalf; a direct local run by corpus id stays possible but can never rank.

source.citation: Mager et al. (2021). Findings of the AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task on Open Machine Translation for Indigenous Languages of the Americas. AmericasNLP 2021.

license.aiTraining: Held-out shared-task test set; not licensed for training. doNotTrain protects benchmark integrity.
license.notes: The AmericasNLP 2021 repo states NO single license and aggregates heterogeneous per-language corpora with distinct (and in the Quechua/JW300 case, religious) provenance. Tagged commercial=false / redistribution=false so it stays out of every prize, commercial, and API lane (license_use.py), and quarantined pending a docs/LICENSING.md review. Champollion never hosts the content — it is fetched from the pinned upstream commit on demand.

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Held-out shared-task benchmark: training on it defeats its purpose. Upstream license is UNSTATED and mixes heterogeneous sources (incl. religious JW300 for Quechua) — kept out of every commercial / prize / API lane and held (excluded from queue, contests, and ranking) until per-language terms are stated or a grant is recorded. Content is fetched from source, never hosted.

contamination.reasoning: AmericasNLP 2021 test set — public since 2021 and in essentially every frontier model's training crawl. Maximally memorized, so its scores are valid only for relative method-vs-method comparison on this exact corpus, never as absolute translation quality. Forced HIGH here and via build_registry.HELD_OUT_BENCHMARK_FAMILIES.

quarantineReason: License review 2026-08-24: HELD. No single upstream license; the set aggregates heterogeneous per-language corpora with distinct provenance (incl. religious-source JW300 for Quechua), and mixed or unstated terms are never interpreted on the rights-holders' behalf. Catalogued; excluded from the queue, contests, and ranking (DB trigger, migration 022); remote transmission refused (consent-required). A direct local run stays possible but its result can never rank. Clears per language as terms are stated, or by a recorded grant.

excluded.nah: Axolotl corpus mixes Nahuatl varieties under the macro code 'nah'; the project has no 'nah' macro card and mapping it to a specific variety (nci/nhi/…) would misrepresent the data.
